en: Black‑and‑white image showing an interior display of many brooms and brushes arranged on a tall wooden rack against a wall. On both sides hang dark patterned carpets. Above and around the rack are several printed signs in Cyrillic script. The floor has a tiled border. The composition and printing style resemble an early‑20th‑century commercial or exhibition postcard.
